title: Abazimbi b’Empagi Engulumivu
intro: Oyimiridde mu maaso g’amatongo g’ekibuga eky’edda ekinene ennyo, nga kati empagi zaakyo empanvu zigudde. Empewo ewowoggana mu nguudo ezitaliimu bantu, ng’etwala ekijjukizo ky’abantu ab’amaanyi abaali bafuga ensi zino. Baali baani?
clues: Twali bantu ba maanyi nnyo n’obukugu, abamanyiddwa olw’ebizimbe byaffe ebinene n’empukuuka ey’omulembe.
Twabeera mu nsi erimu ebiwonvu by’omusenyu n’obusozi obw’amayinja, era twakkiriza nti tewali ayinza kutuwangula.
Omubaka yajja gye tuli okuva mu b’eŋŋanda zaffe, ng’atuyita tusinza Allah yekka, naye ne tumugaana era ne tumusekerera.
Twewaana nti, ‘Ani atusinga amaanyi?’. ne tweyongerayo mu kwegulumiza kwaffe n’okusinza ebifaananyi.
Allah yatusindikira empewo ey’obusungu eyafuuwa ekiro musanvu n’ennaku munaana, n’esaanyawo buli kimu.
Ffe twali bantu ba ‘Adi, abazimbi ba Iramu, era enkomerero yaffe yafuuka okulabula eri bonna abajja oluvannyuma.

outcome.label: Enkomerero yaabwe yali etya?
options: Baasaanyizibwawo era ebisigalira byabwe ne bifuuka eky’okuyiga
outcome.answer: Baasaanyizibwawo era ebisigalira byabwe ne bifuuka eky’okuyiga

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
